desc: Map test files to production code and identify untested areas
context: Read app/tests/** and build a coverage map: for each production file in app/api/**, app/llms/**, app/knowledge/**, app/embeddings/**, app/prompts/**, app/auth/**, app/config/**, identify if a corresponding test file exists. Note which production files have zero tests. Look for test file naming patterns to understand test organisation.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage map produced for all production zones
Production files with zero test coverage listed
Overall coverage estimate per zone provided
